svg.title: Observed — BEV error by GT range
svg.desc: Lower BEV error is better. Shared vertical scale across all conditions; GT range bins retain unsupported 80+ values. Point tooltips include exact values, support, source SHA and claim IDs. Nulls are not zero.
svg.text: Observed — BEV error by GT range
Lower BEV error is better. Shared vertical scale across all conditions; GT range bins retain unsupported 80+ values.
All fixed seeds shown. Fixed-three-seed mean is a paired statistic, not an ensemble. Intervals are pointwise, not simultaneous.
Zero references across axes are not independent studies. Identity timing stress is separate in the full report. No real-vehicle safety claim.
Hover a point for exact values and provenance. × below an axis means unavailable; colors match the method legend.

g.text: GT range bin (metres) · unavailable lane below
